name: Prospect of Faith
summary: Hammertoe Grez, nursing wounds, sends you with the amulet to Prospector Ryedol in the Badlands. Ryedol knows what Hammertoe was seeking, and what the Shadowforge clan must not be allowed to find.

sections.title: An Amulet for Ryedol
sections.body: Hammertoe Grez, clutching at wounds, pauses to steady himself, then asks you to find Ryedol and hand over the amulet. Hammertoe is sure Ryedol will figure out what to do. Ryedol knows Hammertoe was seeking the origins of their people, and that Hammertoe also meant to thwart the Shadowforge clan, who cannot be permitted to get hold of the scrolls.

sections.title: At Ryedol's Hands
sections.body: Ryedol, on receiving Hammertoe's amulet, says that spirits were higher when Hammertoe was thought dead, since knowing for sure only makes the pain worse. Ryedol calls the amulet Hammertoe's life's work and vows that the death will not be in vain.

faq.answer: Prospector Ryedol is the one you are to bring Hammertoe's amulet to, in the Badlands. Ryedol knows what Hammertoe was seeking.

faq.q: What is Hammertoe Grez trying to stop?
faq.answer: Hammertoe wanted to thwart the Shadowforge clan, who cannot be permitted to get hold of the scrolls.
The origins of their people, according to Hammertoe.

faq.q: Which chain is this step part of?
faq.answer: This is part of the chain that began with A Sign of Hope.
